title: Evidence Record
description: An evidence record states that a verification ran (type run), that a person attests a node (type attestation) or that a deploy found the installed version of a third party (type install-check), against one code tree. One record per file, spec/extras/verification/evd-<id>.json, written by the toolkit and never by hand. The file holds a records array of exactly one record, and the file name without .json is the record id. It carries no timestamp: the git author and commit date the record.

records.description: The one evidence record of this file.

items.description: An evidence record. A run names a verification record and holds the exit code, the guard result and the hash of the output; an attestation names the nodes a person attests and holds the git author; an install-check names one third party and holds the versions installed at deploy. Each of the three holds only its own fields.

evidence_id.description: Id of this record: evd- followed by a kebab-case name. Equals the file name without .json.

type.description: run: the commands of a verification record ran. attestation: a person states that the node holds. install-check: the deploy job found the installed version of a third party (an audit trail; no proof reads it). Default run.

about.description: Ids of what the record is about: for a run, the verification record it ran (one item); for an attestation, the nodes attested; for an install-check, the one third-party node checked.

stage.description: Stage at which the run happened or the attestation was made: dev, ci, staging or prod. Default dev.

tested_tree.description: Id of the code tree the run or the attestation is about (a git tree id).

exit_code.description: Exit code of the run. A run only.

guard_matched.description: Whether the output of the run matched the output guard of the verification record. A run only.

output_hash.description: Hash of the output of the run: sha256: and 64 lower-case hex digits. Never a hash of this record. A run only.

installed_versions.description: Version of each third party as installed: third-party node id to version string. A run holds the third parties the verified nodes rely on; an install-check holds the one it checked. Never on an attestation.

recorded_hashes.description: Content hash of each node the record rests on, as it was when the tool wrote the record: node id to hash. A run holds the verifier and each proved target; an attestation holds the attested nodes. Never on an install-check.

git_author.description: The git author of the person who attested: name and email as git reports them. An attestation only.

env.description: Name of the environment the install-check was made for (the deploy job's --env). An install-check only.

tag.description: Release tag the deploy job deployed (the deploy job's --tag). Optional. An install-check only.
